title: Customer Data Analyst (Contract)
description:
Customer Data Analyst

Hybrid

£400 per day

Inside IR35

3-Month Contract


This is an exciting opportunity to join a high-profile customer analytics transformation programme, supporting global stakeholders and delivering insight-led solutions that influence customer strategy. The assignment combines hands-on dashboard development with customer analytics, testing measurement, and data storytelling.


The Company

They are a well-established analytics and customer insight consultancy delivering large-scale transformation projects for global consumer brands. Their teams help organisations better understand customer behaviour, optimise CRM performance, and develop data-driven strategies. This engagement sits within a fast-paced, collaborative environment focused on improving customer measurement and reporting capabilities.


The Role and Deliverables

  • Build and enhance Tableau dashboards using data from Snowflake, translating wireframes into scalable reporting solutions.
  • Develop customer-focused reporting across acquisition, retention, customer lifecycle, basket value, engagement, and campaign performance metrics.
  • Support the migration and redevelopment of reporting assets, including the recreation of previously decommissioned dashboards.
  • Deliver measurement frameworks for customer testing activity, including test and control methodologies and incremental performance reporting.
  • Provide analytical insight and recommendations that help stakeholders understand customer behaviour and optimise decision making.


Your Skills & Experience

  • Strong experience building dashboards in Tableau and working with Snowflake and SQL.
  • Ability to design reporting solutions from wireframes and business requirements.
  • Experience analysing customer, CRM, loyalty, or marketing performance data in B2C environments.
  • Strong understanding of customer segmentation, churn, retention, purchasing behaviour, and customer lifecycle analytics.
  • Knowledge of experimentation, test-and-learn methodologies, test/control design, and campaign measurement.
  • Ability to communicate insights effectively through data storytelling and stakeholder engagement.
  • Comfortable working across multiple industries and translating complex business challenges into analytical solutions.
  • Experience working within an agency, consultancy, or client-facing analytics environment is highly beneficial.
  • Proactive approach with strong ownership, critical thinking, and problem-solving capability.


How to Apply

Register your interest by sending your CV to Ananya Gupta via the Apply Link on this page.
